explain.say: Here are your friend-making steps: smile, say hi, ask a question, invite them to play, and if they say no, try again later. Well done! Here is a challenge: try the first two steps with someone new this week.

steps.label: Smile
steps.note: A smile says: I am friendly.

steps.label: Try again
steps.note: Not everyone says yes. That is okay.

faq.q: What if I feel shy about making friends?
faq.a: Lots of people feel shy, even grown-ups, so you are not alone. Start small: just smile and say hi. It gets a little easier every time you try.
asks: I am too shy to make friends
How do I make friends if I am shy?

faq.q: What can I say to start being friends?
faq.a: Try your name and a kind comment or question, like: Hi, I am Leo. That is a cool ball. Do you play every day? Talking about what they are doing is the easiest start.
asks: What do I say to a new kid?
Tell me about the Say hi and your name

faq.a: That is okay, and it does not mean something is wrong with you. They might be busy or already in a game. Try again another day, or say hi to someone else.
asks: What if someone does not want to be my friend?
Tell me about the Try again

faq.q: How do you keep a new friend?
faq.a: Spend time together, be kind, take turns, and remember things they tell you, like the name of their pet. Friendships grow slowly, a little bit each day.

faq.q: How long does it take to make a friend?
faq.a: It is different for everyone. One study in the USA found it takes about 50 hours together to become casual friends, and about 200 hours to become close friends.
asks: How many hours to become best friends?

facts: A 2018 study by Jeffrey Hall found it takes about 50 hours together to become casual friends and about 200 hours to become close friends.
The United Nations marks the International Day of Friendship every year on 30 July.

quiz.say: Amara wants to make a friend. Which is the best first thing to say?

options.show: Hi, I am Amara. I love your drawing!
options.say: Hi, I am Amara. I love your drawing!

quiz.why: Your name plus a kind comment is a friendly, easy way to start.

wrong.2: Staring without words can make the other person feel uneasy.

quiz.say: You ask someone to play and they say no. What is a good thing to do?

options.show: Say okay, then try later or ask someone else
options.say: Say okay, then try later or ask someone else

quiz.why: A no is often about timing, not about you. Trying again or asking someone else keeps you on track.

wrong.0: One no does not mean nobody likes you.
wrong.2: Shouting would make them less likely to play next time.
